data.title: STATIC SIGNAL — SEAL CHECK 🔍
data.statement:
<<This clash is in Reverse mode only.>>

A rival who calls himself STATIC floods the ruins with stolen field notes — some real, most forged. Paul protects his own by sealing each with a quiet self-check only the authentic ones satisfy.

Observe which transmissions PAT marks {{AUTHENTIC}} and which it marks {{FORGED}}. Find the seal. Reproduce it.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

This clash is in Reverse mode only.

A rival who calls himself STATIC floods the ruins with stolen field notes — some real, most forged. Paul protects his own by sealing each with a quiet self-check only the authentic ones satisfy.

Observe which transmissions PAT marks AUTHENTIC and which it marks FORGED. Find the seal. Reproduce it.
Input
Line 1: An integer N, the number of transmissions.

Next N lines: A string T — a message followed by a space and a single check digit.
Output
N lines: AUTHENTIC or FORGED for each transmission.
Constraints
3 ≤ N ≤ 9

2 ≤ length of T ≤ 99

T consists of printable ASCII characters; the last character is a digit (0–9).
Example
Input
3
Stay low 7
Move now 0
Pat online 9
Output
AUTHENTIC
FORGED
AUTHENTIC
